title: Spectacles gen 1 announced: single camera, 115° FOV circular video
detail: Snap announced its first Spectacles camera glasses with a single fixed-focus camera, 115° FOV, recording circular video for Snapchat.

title: Spectacles gen 1 released via Snapbot vending machines
detail: First Spectacles went on sale through Snapbot vending machines.

title: TechInsights teardown of Spectacles: Ambarella A12, Kingston ePOP, Nordic nRF51822
detail: TechInsights 'Deep Dive Teardown' of Spectacles gen 1 identified Ambarella A12 camera SoC, Kingston ePOP memory and Nordic nRF51822.

title: Spectacles 2 released; cumulative sales 220,000 pairs by May 2018
detail: Spectacles 2 released; cumulative sales reported at 220,000 pairs as of May 2018.

title: Spectacles 3 announced: two HD cameras, US$380 (released Nov 2019)
detail: Spectacles 3 announced with two HD cameras at US$380; released November 2019.

title: Spectacles gen 4: first AR display, 2 RGB cameras, Snapdragon XR1, developer-only
detail: Fourth-generation Spectacles introduced an AR display with two RGB cameras on Snapdragon XR1; developer-only distribution.

title: Spectacles '24 (gen 5) to developers: 2 RGB + 2 IR cameras, 46° FOV, 226 g, US$99/mo
detail: Spectacles '24 available to developers 'starting today': 2 RGB + 2 IR cameras, 2 LCoS waveguides (WaveOptics), 46° diagonal FOV, 37 PPD, 120 Hz, 226 g, 2 Snapdragons, 45-min battery, depth sensor, 6 mics, GPS; US$99/month on 12-month commitment. Camera resolut

title: Snap IR: 'Snap to Launch New Lightweight, Immersive Specs in 2026' (AWE 2025)
detail: Snap investor-relations press release commits to 'launching lightweight, immersive Specs in 2026'; cites 400,000+ developers and OpenAI/Gemini and Niantic Spatial VPS partners.

title: Karl Guttag: Spectacles 5 is 'a developer kit, not a consumer product'
detail: Guttag analysis identifies LCoS from Compound Photonics and WaveOptics waveguides (Snap-owned since 2021); Snap VP Hardware Scott Myers declined 2026 specifics.

title: Spectacles OS 2.0 released; sixth-gen 'expected to launch next year', 'lighter and smaller'
detail: Snap released Spectacles OS 2.0 and reiterated that the sixth-generation consumer glasses are expected next year, lighter and smaller.

title: Specs hardware demonstrated at CES 2026 (Snap pavilion)
detail: Specs hardware shown at CES 2026 in the Snap pavilion by product manager Russell Patton.

title: Snap creates wholly-owned subsidiary Specs Inc.; consumer Specs 'later in 2026'
detail: Snap establishes Specs Inc. for 'greater operational focus'; consumer Specs due 'later in 2026' with no firm date; form factor 'expected to change before public launch'.

title: Specs Inc. and Qualcomm multi-year Snapdragon XR partnership; Specs 'later this year'
detail: Specs Inc. and Qualcomm announce a multi-year partnership covering a Snapdragon XR SoC for Specs and future iterations; both 'reaffirmed that Snap's next-gen Specs are coming later this year'.

title: Report: Specs ~US$2,500, fall 2026; Snap eyes US$1bn fundraise for Specs
detail: Alex Heath (Sources newsletter) via 9to5Google: Specs priced around US$2,500 for fall 2026, Snap seeking a ~US$1 billion raise for Specs, keynote planned at AWE June 2026.

title: Specs: four cameras reported (2 RGB + 2 IR); megapixels/autofocus not disclosed
detail: Tom's Guide live coverage reports four cameras on Specs: 2 RGB for photo/video and 2 IR for hand tracking and spatial mapping; no megapixel or focus-type figure disclosed.

title: Snap newsroom: SPECS Intelligence, SPECS for Enterprise (Salesforce/AWS/NVIDIA)
detail: Newsroom posts 'Introducing SPECS Intelligence', 'New Ways to Work with SPECS for Enterprise' (field service, remote support, retail; Salesforce/AWS/NVIDIA partners) and 'How Visionaries Are Bringing SPECS to Life'.

title: Startup Fortune: Snap 'starts shipping' Specs; initial run capped at ~100,000 units
detail: Claims Snap began shipping Specs the week of Sept 23 to early pre-order customers with initial production 'capped at approximately 100,000 units'; reviews split. Conflicts with Snap's own 2026-10-02 wording that shipping is 'expected to begin later this fall'.

title: MIXED: LA pop-up open; US$200 deposit 'is not an order confirmation'; ship 'later this fall'
detail: Snap says the US$200 deposit 'is not an order confirmation', balance due 'closer to the shipping window', shipping 'expected to begin later this fall' (US/UK/France); 6 MEMS mics, Swiss TR90 frames, 60-language translation, 14-day returns.
